text: Patient: Margaret Chen, age 78. Address: 412 Elm Street, San Francisco, CA 94117. Margaret is a retired schoolteacher with a warm disposition. She lives alone since her husband passed three years ago. Primary conditions: congestive heart failure (CHF), Type 2 diabetes, hypertension. Current medications: Lisinopril 10mg daily, Metoprolol 25mg twice daily, Metformin 500mg twice daily, Furosemide 20mg daily. Allergies: penicillin (rash), sulfa drugs. Last physical: 2025-09-15 with Dr. Patel (primary care). Upcoming: Cardiology follow-up with Dr. Torres at UCSF was last completed 2025-06-02 — next appointment overdue. Grocery preferences: low-sodium diet, no shellfish, prefers organic produce when available. Staples: whole grain bread, oatmeal, bananas, Greek yogurt, salmon. Financial: autopay on PG&E, AT&T, and Medicare Advantage premium. Emergency contacts: daughter Linda Chen +1-415-555-0192, son David Chen +1-415-555-0317.
